segments.comment: Independent C-first ordinary drop witness for do.c:dropz -> ball.c:drop_ball. A debug Valkyrie wishes and reads punishment, picks up the attached iron ball, wishes and drinks levitation, then drops the ball while unable to reach the floor. The production path is drop -> hitfloor -> dropz(with_impact), which bypasses the separate ordinary drop preflight.
